purpose: Keep the low-quality legacy educational/infographic images identified in the September 13, 2026 dtfseeds.com visual audit off every public-facing site surface and prevent automated publishers from reintroducing them.
rule: No image is better than a low-quality or contextually wrong image. Public cards, product/genetics surfaces, tools, education landing pages, and navigation surfaces may only use visuals that have been explicitly approved for that exact role.
notes: This policy targets the legacy low-quality infographic/diagram media family that has been appearing as large card imagery and unrelated product/genetics/tool imagery.
The underlying source files may remain in repository history for reference, but they are not approved public website visuals.
Future approved educational graphics must be republished through a new approved-media path rather than recycling the dtf-edu-* WordPress media family.
The site must never satisfy an image-count target by inserting an unapproved visual.
